/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 - <<'PY'
from solution import load_people
h = 'name,email,age,active\\n'
valid = [
    (h, []),
    ('\\ufeff active , age , email , name \\r\\nTRUE,00130, A@B , \"x\"\\r\\n'.replace(' \"x\"', 'x'), [{'name':'x','email':'a@b','age':130,'active':True}]),
    (h+'\"A, B\\nC\",\"A@B\",0,FALSE\\n', [{'name':'A, B\\nC','email':'a@b','age':0,'active':False}]),
    (h+'\"A \"\"B\"\"\",a@b,,\\n', [{'name':'A \"B\"','email':'a@b','age':None,'active':False}]),
    (h+'\\n , , , , \\nX,x@y,'+'0'*5000+'1,0', [{'name':'X','email':'x@y','age':1,'active':False}]),
]
for source, expected in valid:
    assert load_people(source) == expected
invalid = ['', '\\n'+h, 'name,email,age,name\\n', 'name,email,age,active,extra\\n', '\\ufeff\\ufeff'+h,
           h+'A,a@b,1,true,extra', h+'A,a@b,1', h+'\"A,a@b,1,true',
           h+'A\"B,a@b,1,true', h+'\"A\"x,a@b,1,true', h+'\"A\" ,a@b,1,true']
for email in ['', '@b', 'a@', 'a@@b', 'a b@c', 'a@b\\tc']:
    invalid.append(h+f'A,{email},1,true')
for age in ['-1', '+1', '1.0', '١', '１２', '131', '9'*5000]:
    invalid.append(h+f'A,a@b,{age},true')
for active in ['yes', '2', 'none']:
    invalid.append(h+f'A,a@b,1,{active}')
invalid += [h+',a@b,1,true', h+'A,a@b,1,true\\nB,b@c,200,false']
for source in invalid:
    try:
        load_people(source)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(repr(source[:120]))
print(f'Passed {len(valid)} valid and {len(invalid)} invalid edge cases')
PY
